items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: they got ahold of him and talked him into coming again, just to direct it. We were paying him a hundred dollars a week to just direct the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, Longview. And he tried to sell Cab some stock. But Cab didn't have... He didn't know what the oil was. But he was into oil, and he knew about it. He went to study... His son wound up being a vice-president over here in New Jersey at Standard Oil. And he... He went to school...I understand... I don't know whether this story is accurate or not. But he went to school with one of the African fellows, where they found that oil in Africa, and it was through him that the United States got the deal. He did it on…
